## 9a1157936e2b

**Classification: reproduced lesson shortcut under an explicit lawful lesson
assembly; deployment severity depends on the importer’s lesson-window policy.**

Generator SHA-256:
`64ef3d845947f3b73e92022e9b07bdbcbc0d322cd7ca047632abd808642f44a0`.
Executed rule hash: `65e4dadfe784`.

At medium difficulty, seed `25`, consecutive sample indices `0,1,2` form a
three-demonstration lesson in which the canonical clockwise rotation and the
plausible rival “rotate counterclockwise” produce identical normalized stamps.
On sample index `3`, the two rotations differ. All four inputs pass the target’s
`self_check`. Protected Racket execution agrees with the rival on the three
demonstrations and disagrees on the query: `[true, true, true, false]`.

The complete hash-bound reproducer is
`checks/audit/9a1157936e2b/counterexample.json`; generation and assembly tools
are beside it. The protected result is
`checks/audit/9a1157936e2b/racket.json`. The lesson assembly is stated exactly
as “same seed, consecutive sample indices 0..2; query 3.” The generator does
not declare a training schedule, so this proves that an ordinary deterministic
three-example window can be ambiguous, not that every downstream importer
uses that exact window.

The unmodified generator also fails three of twelve battery stages: lint,
defect lint, and override contract. Its override report records `60,349`
findings in total, including `51,628` exact size mismatches and `8,370`
self-check failures; unknown override keys are accepted. It has no pinned
`RULE_HASH`, and declared helpful texture values are behaviorally dead. See
`checks/audit/9a1157936e2b/battery/checks/9a1157936e2b_before_battery_summary.json`.

**Suggested repair, not applied:** make complete lessons include at least one
asymmetric template that distinguishes clockwise from counterclockwise
rotation; declare and test the real lesson schedule; pin the rule; and replace
the current override metadata with controls the generator actually honors.

triage.reason: Both findings-only audits read and transported in their task indexes. Targets unchanged. Independently reproduce pinned overrides or actual-reference witnesses before source repair; validator-only extension witnesses do not establish in-domain label defects.
